controls.name: genuine_cache
command:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,py_compile,sys,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); names=json.loads(sys.argv[2]); evidence=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cneh-cache-oracle-') as directory:
 for index,name in enumerate(names):
  cache=root/name; source=pathlib.Path(importlib.util.source_from_cache(str(cache)))
  expected=pathlib.Path(directory)/str(index)
  py_compile.compile(str(source),cfile=str(expected),dfile=str(source),doraise=True,invalidation_mode=py_compile.PycInvalidationMode.TIMESTAMP)
  actual_bytes=cache.read_bytes(); expected_bytes=expected.read_bytes()
  if actual_bytes!=expected_bytes: raise ValueError('cache does not reproduce from canonical source: '+name)
  evidence.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(actual_bytes).hexdigest(),'expected_sha256':hashlib.sha256(expected_bytes).hexdigest(),'status':'EXACT_INTERPRETER_COMPILE_MATCH'})
print(json.dumps(evidence,sort_keys=True))
